scan_scope.selection_note: Bounded first pass in one Yharnam region. Carrier IDs are search seeds; connectivity in the original world proposes boundaries, not model names or F families. Adjacent independent props may still be grouped; user can split or mark context.

candidate_policy: Proposals only. No automatic migration, no inherited family boundaries, no semantic approval.

candidates.hypothesis: Дерево / растительность: конечная группа соседних source carriers; граница требует ручной проверки
candidates.boundary_method: 26-neighbor source connectivity; listed tree carriers also use horizontal radius 1 / vertical gap <=6. Excludes masonry. No F-family input. Hypothesis only.
candidates.count_scope: Only explicitly listed source terrain regions; exact complete carrier cluster modulo Y rotation, not whole-world occurrence count
candidates.context_policy: Separate one-cell shell around carrier bounds; never automatically part of candidate
